title: Veilforge
tagline: A duskbound idle RPG of remnant crafts, war-arts, and the last workshop under a broken sky.
overall: Critic-pass wave 17: hour-one deaths, overnight dump-halts, offline hunts, save hygiene, and lock/glyph grammar are in. Unique Imagine cells still sit at 28px without a painted atlas. Still not a Melvor tutorial. Do not claim Melvor Idle 2 was beaten.

comparison.melvorIdle: Offline combat now resolves (pause on death); vault halt and first-hour beat scan are closer to Melvor's overnight trust. First hour is still thinner than Melvor's gated tutorial
comparison.melvorIdle2: Quay commissions and pet ledger exist; drop-table UI and a real completion log still missing
comparison.runescape: Death modal names the blow; paperdoll shows set bonus. Meshes are still primitive dusk stubs
comparison.oursBetter: Telegraphed burst + full-HP mercy, per-mark Whisper heat, structured combat floaters, save strip of _ transients
comparison.biggestGap: painted 24px icon atlas vs lookalike Imagine cells; Melvor tutorial gate; combat depth

pieces.name: One job, Halt overlay
pieces.critic: G2: input-less gathers halt on unique/stack dump. One Halted ledger line + sink hint.

pieces.name: Timber Trawl Vein Ember groves
pieces.critic: Gather loop intact. 3h offline timber still holds when outputs can land. Dock Relief remains a dusk tax.

pieces.name: Hearth Anvil Fletch Loom Sigil Vial
pieces.critic: Quiet cards + craft dock. Crafting still halt-on-missing-input. Quay commissions are a coin sink past the tool ladder.

pieces.name: Course Whisper Soil Drove Chart
pieces.critic: G6: heat is per mark, not global. Compost toggle sits above plantPlot. Dead Chart study buttons gone.

pieces.name: Vault 3D + Wanderer kit
pieces.critic: G5: ledger pet grid N/22 with named vs ???? and source hints. Inspect still explains Splinter.

pieces.name: Lantern Quay shop
pieces.critic: Sold-out vs progression-lock are two looks (dim vs lock glyph). Dusk commissions rotate. Fence rate falls with tier.

pieces.name: Unlock cascade and goals
pieces.critic: BEAT-1: firstHourBeat scans FIRST_HOUR, not active[0]. Food-0 heals 7; q-cook 36 rations; auto-eat starts at 40%.

pieces.name: Whole-game connective tissue
pieces.critic: SAVE_VERSION ladder, persistable() strips _, HUD save-fail never serializes. Flavor still outruns teaching.

pieces.name: Fights food triangle specials
pieces.critic: G1: burst wind-up + scaled burst + mercy cap. G3: offline hunts tick. Death modal names burst/poison/starve. Depth still trails Melvor.

pieces.name: Icons, models, paperdoll, dioramas
pieces.critic: A1 best-effort: unique Imagine cells, no hue-rotate, no painted 24px atlas. Duel bars 14px; lock glyphs; radius tokens. PWA veilforge-v19.

pieces.name: Phone and tablet shell
pieces.critic: ≤720px bottom dock; ≤1100px one-column workshop; desktop three-column untouched.

log: Wave 17: critic pass G1–G8, G10, E1–E10, BEAT-1, A3/A6/A7 plus feasible A1/A2/A4/A5/A8–A10. Selftest collector. PWA v19.
Wave 17: burst telegraph + mercy; gather halt on dump; offline combat; per-mark Whisper heat; death modal; quay commissions.
Wave 17: persistable() strips _; SAVE_VERSION ladder; offline truncation flag; structured combatLog; firstHourBeat scan.
Wave 16: mobile app-shell (bottom dock, swipe skills, shorter scene, ledger hidden). Settings export/import. PWA v18.
Wave 16: skill-locked quay tiles dim like sold-out Auto-Eat; Pay stays disabled. Shop removed from the skill rail.
Wave 16: Lantern Quay is a Shop desk — keepers, dusk bargain (−18%), hunger pawn 72%.
Wave 16: quiet job cards + craft dock, Anvil/Fletch tabs, batch 1/5/10/25/All/Until halt.
Wave 16: full-review blockers; item icons follow kind (not gem-for-wood).
Wave 15: merge origin/main yield-drip with critic-wave Last yield + unique Imagine icons.
Wave 14: Goal strip with numbered first-hour chain; XP % on skill nav.
Wave 13: per-action +item/+xp drips; workshop floaters; offline skips drip spam.
Wave 12: SVG glyphs, monster kinds, dungeon gates, workshop paperdoll.
Wave 11: unique-skill identity, combat ops, vault ops.
